8.2.3 PduR_RoutingPathGroupIdType
The routing path group ID is used for identifying a specific group of routing paths. Since
a PduRRoutingPath links one source I-PDU and one destination I-PDU, it is possible
to enable/disable routing per network or per PDU kind.
